baseline_models.reading: Aad and Thamud are recalled through dwelling-sites made clear to the audience: Satan made their intentional deeds appear attractive, turned them from the way, and did so despite their discernment.

focus_anchor.role: The clear dwelling reference supplies the visible-evidence side of the reading.

activation_trace.role: The becoming-clear image makes the dwelling reference evidential, not merely locational.
The dwelling-and-settlement scope anchors مَّسَٰكِنِهِمْ as habitation.
The making-beauty image supplies the apparent attractiveness of the deeds.
The intentional-doing scope identifies what was beautified as their deeds.
Turning away and preventing supplies the movement away from the route.
The traversed-way scope gives ٱلسَّبِيلِ its route or course sense.
The inner-sight scope supports discernment in مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: The consecutive wording presents beautification as leading into diversion.
The closing clause places discernment beside their diversion.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus moves from visible habitation evidence to a causal diagnosis: attractive appearance attaches to their deeds, which produces removal from the way, while discernment remains present as a tension rather than a cure.
baseline_models.reader_inference: Supplied are clear dwelling-sites, beautified deeds, diversion, and discernment, with the cited lexical images. The reader infers a diagnostic sequence from their ordering. It remains live whether مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes literal perception, moral insight, or both, and the wording does not settle how Satanic action relates to human agency.
baseline_models.containment: Keep the claim to the focus's stated evidence, deeds, diversion, and discernment; do not specify the sites, the deeds, or a fuller historical account.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's clear dwelling-sites can be heard in the nearby pattern of a clear sign addressed to people who reason, making them a warning-bearing trace rather than bare scenery.

focus_anchor.role: The phrase combines disclosure with habitation-sites.

activation_trace.role: The focus uses the image of something becoming manifest.
The earlier residue is explicitly imaged as a visible sign.
The same clarity image joins that sign to the focus's becoming-clear wording.
Reasoning is presented as the fitting reception of the clear sign.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
structural_cues.role: Immediately before the focus, what is left is framed as a clear sign for reasoning.
The focus repeats disclosure through an inhabited-place reference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent recurrence of leaving, clarity, and rational reception makes the focus's dwelling reference function rhetorically like a readable trace.

changed_reading.before: The dwellings are known or visible sites associated with Aad and Thamud.
changed_reading.after: Within the sequence, the sites also invite sign-reading and reflection.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical and sequential repetition. The reader supplies the parallel between accounts; 29:35 explicitly concerns its own preceding locale, while 29:38 does not explicitly call these dwellings an āyah.
context_deltas.containment: Present this as a contextual resonance, not as a claim that 29:35 and 29:38 identify the same place or that the focus names the dwelling-sites an āyah.

context_deltas.reading: The Satanic beautification is framed as morally consequential without becoming an excuse: the surrounding collection assigns taking to each one's culpable act and says the wronging was self-inflicted.

focus_anchor.role: The focus gives the external beautification of their own deeds.

activation_trace.role: The focus identifies the relevant objects as intentional deeds.
Diversion is the stated consequence of the beautification.
The culpable-consequence image makes the later taking explicitly responsive to fault.

structural_cues.role: The collective sequel assigns taking to each one's fault.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
structural_cues.role: The sequel explicitly denies wrongful treatment and attributes wronging to themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the catalog containing the focus pair, the collective conclusion recasts the focus's deception-and-diversion sequence inside an accountability frame: beautification acts upon their deeds, but their deeds and self-wronging remain consequential.

changed_reading.before: Satanic beautification may be heard chiefly as the cause of their diversion.
changed_reading.after: The surrounding sequence retains their own culpable action and self-wronging as the accountable side of that diversion.

context_deltas.reader_inference: Supplied are the immediate catalog and the later each-one formulation. The reader infers that its retrospective collection includes Aad and Thamud, though its scope may also include further preceding groups. The texts do not resolve a fuller theory of divine, satanic, and human causation.
context_deltas.containment: Do not turn this into a claim that the focus denies satanic influence; state instead that the contextual frame does not let influence erase responsibility.

context_deltas.reading: The ending's discernment is sharpened into an irony: recognition or perception can coexist with being turned away from the right course.

focus_anchor.role: The focus itself juxtaposes diversion with discernment.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight provides the focus's discernment side.
The focus's other side is being turned away from a route.
The later turning-away image supplies a close directional counterpart to the focus's diversion.
The later reasoning image distinguishes available recognition from its proper use.

structural_cues.role: An explicit acknowledgment is followed immediately by a question about being turned away.
The later sequence diagnoses a failure of reasoning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later acknowledgment-then-turning pattern gives a concrete rhetorical counterpart to the focus's conjunction of discernment and diversion, making the latter read as unused or misdirected insight rather than simple absence of awareness.

changed_reading.before: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ denotes a general possession of discernment.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can mark the exposed insufficiency of discernment that does not orient conduct toward the way.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the directional and cognitive parallels. The reader infers a thematic analogy across different explicit referents. A live alternative is that مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ is only perceptual awareness and that 29:61 addresses only its own audience.
context_deltas.containment: Do not say Aad and Thamud uttered the later acknowledgment or specify exactly what they knew; retain the reading as a contextual pattern of recognition and misdirection.

context_deltas.reading: The final promise of guidance to divine ways makes the focus's blocked way a negative foil: striving is set against beautified deeds that end in diversion.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the image of exclusion from a traversed way.

activation_trace.role: The focus's way is an extended route or means of reaching.
The final counter-image begins with strenuous expenditure of capacity.
Guidance toward a way or truth reverses the focus's diversion.
The repeated route image makes the counterpoint explicit.

structural_cues.role: The close of the window presents striving followed by guidance to ways.
The focus presents the inverse movement away from the way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated path language at the window's end creates an inverse sequence: Satanic embellishment and blockage in the focus are contrasted with striving and divine guidance in the closing statement.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a retrospective report of diversion from the way.
changed_reading.after: It also functions as the negative side of a window-wide contrast between blocked direction and divinely guided ways.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repeated route vocabulary and opposite directional actions are supplied. The reader infers a deliberate counterpoint across the window; singular ٱلسَّبِيلِ and plural سُبُلَنَا need not encode a further theory about the number of routes.
context_deltas.containment: Do not make 29:69 a direct speech to the focus pair or claim that the focus itself states the final promise.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: Exploratorily, the exposed dwelling-sites can resonate with the later weakest-house image: what appears settled or protective may be materially present yet fail as a reliable shelter, especially where deeds have been made to look attractive.

focus_anchor.role: The focus gives a concrete habitation image from which the shelter analogy begins.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies dwelling and settlement.
Beautification supplies the appearance side of the analogy.
The later parable uses house as shelter and dwelling.
Weakness of strength supplies the later house's structural insufficiency.

structural_cues.role: The focus directs attention to habitation-sites as visible evidence.
The later parable explicitly qualifies a house as weakest.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: A cross-domain housing resonance moves from visible former dwelling-sites to a parabolic house whose appearance as shelter conceals weakness; the focus's beautification language makes the appearance-versus-reliability contrast possible.

changed_reading.before: The dwelling-sites are evidence associated with past peoples.
changed_reading.after: They may additionally evoke a cautious analogy about apparent settlement or protection lacking dependable support.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: Supplied are the focus's dwellings and beautification, and the later weak-house parable. The reader supplies the analogy between distinct housing terms and contexts. A live alternative is that the two images remain independent.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus concerns named peoples and visible dwelling-sites while 29:41 is a parable about taking allies besides God. Do not equate their dwellings with the spider house or attribute 29:41's explicit subject matter directly to Aad and Thamud.

summary.ordinary_reading: Aad and Thamud are recalled through dwelling-sites made clear to the audience; Satan made their deeds attractive and turned them from the way despite their discernment.
coexisting_readings: The nearby clear-sign formula lets the dwelling-sites function as readable warning evidence for reflection.
The collective sequel of taking for fault and self-wronging retains accountability alongside Satanic beautification.
Later acknowledgment followed by turning-away sharpens the focus's discernment as insight that may fail to guide conduct.
The closing promise of guidance to divine ways supplies a counter-image to being barred from the way.
Exploratorily, the dwelling image can resonate with the later weak-house parable without identifying the two.
unresolved_limits: The focus does not specify what precisely became clear from the dwellings or the exact content of مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ.
The sign statement in 29:35 and the acknowledgment statements in 29:61–63 have their own explicit referents; their links to the focus are contextual parallels, not identity claims.
No focus root is listed without branches; the packet's gaps for ك ي ف, ع ث و, and خ ط ط elsewhere in the window provide no additional focus evidence.
